note: Wildmoot Moot Hound (unit identity, Wildmoot; Common; wolf entity): a low, long, head-down cur on the hound rig, a russet fur coat over a bark-dark belly, a dark muzzle with small bone teeth, a pale clay stripe from nose to tail tip, an ochre sinew collar with bone toggles and a ragged team saddle-cloth over the shoulders with hide spikes rising through it. Tier I only. No back flag.
